permit_authority_cards.authority: Wisconsin Department of Safety and Professional Services (DSPS)

inspections.description: Inspector verifies service equipment sizing, grounding and bonding, conductor sizing, panel location and working clearances, disconnects, feeder routing, and that all new circuits are properly protected before walls are closed.
inspections.timing: Before insulation, drywall, or ceiling closure

inspections.description: Inspector verifies fixtures are installed, devices are labeled, service equipment is complete, required covers and plates are in place, plumbing fixtures function without leaks, and the tenant space matches the approved plans.
inspections.timing: After all work is complete and ready for occupancy

notes: Wisconsin DSPS may administer or delegate commercial electrical permitting/inspection. Use DSPS/delegated-agent routing unless a sourced municipal delegation says the city is the commercial electrical authority.
